Name: Slime Pet
Author: NoodleyFelix
Description:
Dialogue and sound effects are not changed, but your pet will become an adorable slime. If you use the optional "Generic Mod Config Menu" you can change which cats and dog breeds are replaced with the slime by changing the variable to "Slime"

otherwise you can change the config file after loading the mod once. by default it will look like 

{
  "Slime Pet": "true",
  "Orange Cat": "Cat",
  "Grey Cat": "Cat",
  "Yellow Cat": "Cat",
  "White Cat": "Cat",
  "Black Cat": "Cat",
  "Iridium Cat": "Cat",
  "Yellow Dog": "Dog",
  "Yellow and Brown Dog": "Dog",
  "Brown Earred Dog": "Dog",
  "Grey Dog": "Dog",
  "Brown Dog": "Dog",
  "Iridium Dog": "Dog"
}

change the value from "Cat" or "Dog" to "Slime" and that pet will be replaced with the slime.
Currently hats don't place in the right spot but i'm looking into trying to fix that.
